_comment: Serious or critical violations accepted for now (ADR-23): each names the rule of axe-core, the screens (all when absent), why, and the request that fixes it.

allowed.why: The value of a select that is read only (the role of the user in a project, the status of an issue) is drawn by NG-ZORRO as disabled, rgba(0,0,0,0.25) on #f5f5f5, about 1.6:1; a read-only field is not disabled and keeps the contrast of the text.
